Sicherer Arbeitsplatz : Arbeite Vollzeit in einem unbefristeten Arbeitsverhältnis in einem krisensicheren, wachstumsorientierten Umfeld

Team- und Firmenevents: Nimm regelmäßig an spannenden Events teil und fördere den Teamgeist

Verantworte die Produktvision, Roadmap und Weiterentwicklung unserer Agent-Assist- und Automatisierungsplattformen entlang der Unternehmensstrategie

Entwickle innovative KI-gestützte Agent-Assist-Funktionen für Telefonie, Chat und E-Mail – von Echtzeit-Empfehlungen über automatisierte Zusammenfassungen bis zur Integration von Wissensdatenbanken
Arbeite eng mit Operations, Data Science, IT-Entwicklung sowie internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen und begleite die Einführung neuer Lösungen bis in den operativen Einsatz
Fördere die Nutzerakzeptanz unserer Produkte, leite Optimierungspotenziale aus KPIs und Nutzerfeedback ab und stelle einen nachhaltigen Business-Impact sicher
Präsentiere Produktfortschritte, moderiere Workshops und bereite Entscheidungsgrundlagen für Management und Stakeholder auf

abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, Product Manager oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle, idealerweise im Contact-Center-, BPO- oder Customer-Service-Umfeld
fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung und Integration von IT-Lösungen, insbesondere im Bereich Contact-Center-Technologien, Voice Services und Cloud-Plattformen
Erfahrung in der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung technischer Systemlandschaften sowie moderner Integrationslösungen
praktische Erfahrung im operativen Betrieb von Contact-Center-Prozessen und IT-Infrastrukturen
Erfahrung mit agilen Arbeitsweisen (z. B. Scrum oder Kanban) sowie gängigen Tools wie Jira oder Confluence
Kommunikationsfähigkeiten im Austausch mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern im verhandlungssicheren Deutsch und Englisch

The eRA Product Manager within Notre Dame Research serves as the strategic owner of the University’s electronic Research Administration (eRA) ecosystem. This position is responsible for the vision, roadmap, governance, and lifecycle management of the administrative systems that support the University’s research enterprise.

The eRA Product Manager partners closely with Notre Dame Research Administration and Compliance, Campus IT, and external software vendors to ensure research administration and compliance platforms align with institutional priorities, federal compliance requirements, and the evolving needs of faculty and research staff.

In this role, the eRA Product Manager acts as a high-level consultant to University leadership, translating strategic research objectives into scalable technology solutions that improve operational efficiency, data integrity, compliance readiness, and proposal competitiveness.

Most immediately, the successful candidate in collaboration with the Associate Vice President of Research and the Director of Research Effectiveness and Analytics will play a defining leadership role in steering the University through a major eRA implementation, shaping the future of Notre Dame’s research infrastructure from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities Define, manage, and execute the product roadmap for the University’s electronic Research Administration systems, prioritizing enhancements and feature releases that streamline workflows and reduce administrative burden.

Serve as the primary liaison between Notre Dame Research Administration and Compliance, Campus IT, and third-party software vendors to advocate for institutional needs and influence product development.

Lead system governance and integration strategy for research administration platforms, ensuring effective data exchange between eRA systems, HRIS, ERP, and other enterprise applications. Oversee research data governance practices to establish consistent standards, improve data quality, and support reliable institutional reporting and analytics.

Configure and maintain system validations and workflows to support evolving federal regulations and sponsor requirements, including NSF, NIH, USDA, and other compliance standards. Collaborate with leadership and stakeholders to identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and enhanced reporting capabilities.

Develop and maintain system documentation, business processes, and training materials to support successful adoption of system enhancements and transitions. Lead “train-the-trainer” initiatives and support change management efforts across the research community.

Monitor system performance, user feedback, and emerging industry trends to inform continuous improvement efforts. Support reporting and data visualization activities to translate research administration data into actionable insights for leadership decision-making.

Support audit readiness activities by ensuring accurate system configurations, data integrity, and compliance documentation. Participate in vendor user groups, professional organizations, and research administration communities to stay informed on best practices and emerging technologies.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Research Administration, or a related field. 7+ years of experience in research administration, enterprise systems management, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in a leadership, Product Owner, Product Manager, or similar strategic systems role.

Experience supporting enterprise-level software implementations, preferably within research administration, ERP, or higher education environments. Expert understanding of the research grant lifecycle, including pre-award, post-award, and compliance functions.

Strong understanding of enterprise systems architecture, integrations, and data governance principles. Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and influence stakeholders without direct supervisory authority. Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and identify operational trends.

Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences, including faculty and senior leadership. Ability to balance strategic planning with operational execution in a dynamic environment. Strong organizational and project management skills with attention to detail and compliance requirements.

Preferred qualifications Experience working within higher education research administration environments. Familiarity with eRA systems, ERP platforms, and SaaS-to-on-premises data integrations. Experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

Knowledge of federal research compliance regulations and sponsored program administration. Please include a cover letter and resume to be considered for this role. Salary up to $113,500, commensurate with experience. Applications due by July 27 2026.

The University of Notre Dame seeks to attract, develop, and retain the highest quality faculty, staff and administration. The University is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national or ethnic origin, sex, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or age in employment.

Moreover, Notre Dame prohibits discrimination against veterans or disabled qualified individuals, and complies with 41 CFR 60-741.5(a) and 41 CFR 60-300.5(a). We strongly encourage applications from candidates attracted to a university with a Catholic identity.

The University of Notre Dame is more than a workplace; it is a vibrant, mission-driven community where every employee is valued and supported. Rooted in a tradition of excellence and inspired by our Catholic character, Notre Dame is committed to fostering an environment of care that nurtures the whole person—mind, body, and spirit.

Here, you will find a deep sense of belonging, a culture that prioritizes well-being, and the opportunity to grow your career while being a force for good in the world.

Whether contributing to world-class research, shaping the student experience, or supporting the University’s mission in other ways, you will be part of a dedicated team working to make a meaningful impact on campus and beyond. At Notre Dame, your work matters, and so do you! Originally posted on Himalayas

Better Money Strike is the Bitcoin company. With Strike , you can buy and sell bitcoin, pay bills, and borrow against your holdings. From individuals to businesses, Strike is purpose-built for every step of the Bitcoin journey.

Available in more than 100 countries — including the U.S., Europe, Latin America, and Africa — Strike is building a better financial system powered by Bitcoin. Bitcoin is better money. Strike is how you use it. Role: Strike is where people around the world send, save, and spend money on bitcoin rails.

For a product like that, customer trust is a feature in and of itself.

As Trust Product Manager, you'll own the features that make customers confident keeping their money with Strike : account security controls, verified support experiences, beneficiary planning, account management, and the systems like KYC/B, transaction limits, account restrictions that keep fraudsters out without getting in the way of good customers.

You'll ship customer-facing features, and you'll own the foundations underneath them, turning what most companies treat as friction into experiences customers actually appreciate.

You'll succeed by shipping trust-building features customers love, minimizing fraud, maintaining compliance, and protecting the health and integrity of the Strike ecosystem. This position is available for candidates located in the eastern US time zone.

What You’ll Do: Serve as the voice of the customer (internal customer too!) and intimately understand the products we offer as well as their potential fraud vectors and blind spots Work closely with Compliance, Finance, Operations, and Data to uncover and understand needs Partner with cross-functional peers to define, prioritize, and deliver a roadmap and product that maximize impact to financial risk management and our fraud strategy Own our Fraud KPIs and partner with Data and Finance to iterate on their definition as needed Establish and track success metrics for various features and initiatives, including operational efficiencies Support and motivate cross-functional teams through an inclusive and collaborative mindset Qualifications: At least 4 years of experience in product management, with at least 2 of those years in trust/fraud related teams A highly experimental mindset to drive innovation amidst uncertainty or ambiguity (e.g., new processes, teams, systems) Vast experience working with designers and user researchers Empathy to work with a diverse array of cross functional peers and stakeholders Resourcefulness, pragmatism and roll-up the sleeves mentality Excellent verbal and written communication skills Experience and interest for Bitcoin and Fintech is a plus US-Based Positions Salary range: $162K - 190K Equity in a high-growth startup Health, dental, and vision insurance premium contributions; short & long-term disability insurance and basic life insurance Cell phone and internet reimbursement Flexible PTO, sick leave & parental leave Access to a company 401k plan We do not make hiring decisions based on educational history whatsoever.

Our Founder is a college dropout. We employ high school dropouts, PHD candidates and everything in-between. We do not hire credentials. We simply hire talented, passionate individuals who are excited to be a part of our team.

At Veracyte , we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment.

This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions. Our Values: We Seek A Better Way : We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.

We Make It Happen : We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way. We Are Stronger Together : We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte , and celebrate as one team. We Care Deeply : We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another.

The Position: The Technical Product Manager will contribute to Veracyte ’s success by leading the product strategy, development, and lifecycle management of our Veracyte workflows, driving improvements in laboratory operations, order-to-cash processes, or analytics capabilities.

This role centers on bridging technical and business needs to optimize workflow efficiency, data handoffs, and data integrity.

In addition to core product management duties, the Technical Product Manager will collaborate closely with engineering, clinical, and analytics teams to champion standards-based solutions that enhance operational performance and support data-driven decision-making.

This is a strategic role supporting Veracyte ’s broader digital transformation in laboratory diagnostics, analytics, and order-to-cash processing. This position is based out of our South San Francisco or San Diego office (hybrid) and we are open to remote (US).

Key Responsibilities : Product Ownership & Strategy Own and manage the product backlog, including prioritization and ongoing grooming Define, maintain, and communicate product roadmaps for new product development and sustaining activities Act as the primary product decision‑maker, balancing scope, value, risk, and technical constraints Requirements & Planning Lead scoping discussions and effort estimation exercises with engineering and cross‑functional teams Elicit, document, and manage requirements, translating user and business needs into clear user stories and acceptance criteria Ensure requirements are well‑defined, traceable, and aligned with overall product strategy Cross‑Functional Collaboration Partner with clinical, scientific, and business stakeholders to understand workflows, user needs, and success criteria Collaborate closely with engineering, SQA, and operations teams to support design, development, and testing activities Coordinate dependencies and resolve ambiguities to keep delivery on track Delivery & Continuous Improvement Support release planning, execution, and readiness, including defect triage and scope trade‑off decisions Monitor product outcomes and stakeholder feedback to drive continuous improvement Maintain clear product documentation and ensure shared understanding across teams Who You Are: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Health Informatics, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in product management, with a focus on technical products in healthcare or software integration.

Prior experience in life sciences or diagnostics required. Experience optimizing at least one of: lab operations, or diagnostic order‑to‑cash, or diagnostic billing/reimbursement workflows, including analytics‑driven systems. Familiarity with Salesforce, or Lab Information Management Systems (LIMS).

Strong technical proficiency, including understanding of APIs, data modeling, cloud services (e.g., AWS, GCP), and software development lifecycle. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Demonstrated ability to manage cross-functional projects in a fast-paced, regulated industry. For candidates based in our South San Francisco office, the salary range is $148,000 - $160,000. For candidates based in our San Diego office, the salary range is $138,000 - $150,000.

For candidates working remote (US), the salary range is $135,000 - $145,000. The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to years of experience, skillset, geographic location, industry, education, etc.

Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.

Pay range $135,000—$160,000 USD What We Can Offer You Veracyte is a growing company that offers significant career opportunities if you are curious, driven, patient-oriented and aspire to help us build a great company.

We offer competitive compensation and benefits, and are committed to fostering an inclusive workforce, where diverse backgrounds are represented, engaged, and empowered to drive innovative ideas and decisions.

We are thrilled to be recognized as a 2024 Certified™ Great Place to Work ® in both the US and Israel - a testament to our dynamic, inclusive, and inspiring workplace where passion meets purpose. About Veracyte Veracyte (Nasdaq: VCYT) is a global diagnostics company whose vision is to transform cancer care for patients all over the world.

We empower clinicians with the high-value insights they need to guide and assure patients at pivotal moments in the race to diagnose and treat cancer.

Our Veracyte Diagnostics Platform delivers high-performing cancer tests that are fueled by broad genomic and clinical data, deep bioinformatic and AI capabilities, and a powerful evidence-generation engine, which ultimately drives durable reimbursement and guideline inclusion for our tests, along with new insights to support continued innovation and pipeline development.

For more information, please visit www.veracyte.com or follow us on LinkedIn or X (Twitter) . Own the product line end-to-end. From discovery to delivery to ongoing maintenance. You decide what gets built, when, and why.

Drive expansion into new markets and commodities. Run discovery in new geographies, pressure-test our offering with local customers, decide where we double down and where we pull back.
Make it action-ready. Data collection is the foundation. Reduction is where customer value compounds. Shape how our primary data product becomes the launchpad for everything we build on top of it.

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.
We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by four leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80 m Series C, we are ready to push beyond.
As a Product Manager for our eCommerce Solutions team , you will contribute to improving an Online Booking Engine (our core white-label product) that our partners use to allow their users to search, book, and manage their ground transportation tickets.

Timely and High-Quality Delivery of Roadmap : Ensure the successful and timely delivery of the product roadmap by collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. This includes:
Achieve on-time delivery of planned iterations and releases, meeting or exceeding project milestones.
Maintain a backlog of well-defined and prioritized user stories that align with customer needs and business goals.
Minimize scope changes and rework through effective communication and requirement validation.
Stakeholder Alignment : Establish strong communication channels with stakeholders and ensure a shared understanding of product vision, progress, and timelines. This includes:
Build and maintain trust-based relationships with stakeholders by providing clear, structured, and consistent communication.
Proactively address stakeholder concerns and manage expectations to ensure alignment with the product roadmap.
Data-informed decisions : Drive continuous improvement of the product through data analysis, user feedback, and iterative development cycles. This includes:
Monitor and analyze key product and team KPIs (e.g., conversion rates, user engagement) to identify opportunities for enhancement.
Utilize data insights to prioritize features and improvements that have the highest impact on user satisfaction and business goals.
Implement iterative development practices, adjusting priorities and features based on real-time feedback and changing market conditions.

We are mainly looking for this role based in Germany, preferably at our headquarters in Berlin. We are a remote-first company, with teams around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office.

At least 3+ years of professional experience as a Product Owner
Have user-centric thinking: Ability to empathize with users, understand their needs, and prioritize features based on their value and impact
Strong communicator: You possess verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey the product vision, requirements, and updates to both the development team and stakeholders
Know Agile Methodology: You are proficient in Agile methodologies (particularly Scrum) to manage iterative development, prioritize work, and respond to changing requirements.
Hands-on with user story writing: You are able to break down complex features into clear and concise user stories that capture user needs, acceptance criteria, and business value.
Technically savvy: You understand the technical aspects of the product domain, allowing effective translation of requirements into actionable tasks for the development team.
Data-driven decision mindset: Your skills in using data and analytics help you make informed decisions, monitor KPIs, and identify areas for product improvement.
Problem-Solving approach: You are able to identify and address challenges that arise during product development, find creative solutions, and make timely adjustments.
Adaptability: You are willing to embrace change and adapt to evolving user needs, market trends, and business priorities
Experience with B2C products is a plus.

You will join a fast-paced travel tech company and take on a rapidly growing industry
You will take on ownership and responsibility from day one and have a direct impact on the success of the company
We value agility! We’re constantly updating our tech stack and offer the best possible tools to ensure all of our in-house engineers, partners, and carriers benefit from cutting-edge, efficient solutions.
You will work with global companies. Our product attracts the biggest names in travel technology, such as Booking.com, and Google Maps, and national carriers like Amtrak, Deutsche Bahn, Renfe, and SNCF.
You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support, and challenge you every day!
We offer flexible and remote working conditions, relocation opportunities, and career growth in a small and developing company

We are building a SaaS platform that packages Autodesk Consulting’s intellectual property — proven workflows, implementation guidance, learning content, and tooling recommendations — into a scalable digital experience that connects customers and internal Autodesk consultants to the knowledge they need to drive successful digital transformation. The platform is new, the roadmap is ambitious, and the details matter enormously.
As Platform Product Owner, you sit at the critical intersection of product vision and engineering execution. You work closely with the Platform Product Manager to deeply understand strategic intent, and you are responsible for translating that intent into well-defined, sprint-ready user stories that development teams can build with confidence.

You collaborate closely with our UI/UX designer to ensure high-fidelity wireframes and prototypes reflect both the product vision and the detailed requirements that make them buildable.

You work directly with scrum teams across India and Poland to clarify requirements at the detail level, resolve ambiguity, and maintain alignment between what gets built and what was intended.
This role requires someone who is energized by the craft of breaking complex problems into clear, executable work — and who understands that maintaining the integrity of the product vision through the details of execution is one of the most important and underappreciated skills in product development.

Break down high-level epics and product requirements into clearly defined, sprint-ready user stories with well-articulated acceptance criteria
Develop a deep understanding of the platform product vision and serve as its guardian at the execution layer, ensuring that detail-level decisions remain true to strategic intent
Work closely with the Platform Product Manager to clarify priorities and translate roadmap direction into actionable work for scrum teams
Collaborate with the UI/UX designer to ensure wireframes and prototypes accurately reflect detailed requirements before development begins
Partner with globally distributed scrum teams in India and Poland to answer questions, resolve ambiguity, and maintain development momentum
Identify gaps, inconsistencies, or risks in requirements early, and escalate or resolve them before they impact delivery
Maintain and manage the product backlog, ensuring it is well-organized, up to date, and accurately reflects current priorities
Adapt to shifting team assignments and priorities as the product and operating model evolve

4+ years of experience in a product ownership or equivalent role
Demonstrated ability to break down complex, ambiguous product requirements into well-defined, executable user stories
Strong capacity to internalize and represent a product vision, maintaining its integrity through detailed execution without requiring constant direction
Experience working directly with engineering teams, including clarifying requirements and supporting development through delivery
Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, early-stage product environment where priorities shift and the operating model continues to evolve
Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across globally distributed teams and time zones
Experience collaborating with UI/UX designers to align detailed requirements with high-fidelity design artifacts
Experience With Technologies Such As
Jira for backlog management and sprint planning

The Ideal Candidate
The ideal candidate understands that product vision is only as strong as the execution that delivers it. They take ownership of the space between strategic direction and engineering delivery — not waiting to be told what every story should say, but actively working to understand the intent behind the roadmap and making thoughtful, independent decisions about how to express that intent in the details.
They are exceptionally good at their craft. Writing clear, well-structured user stories with meaningful acceptance criteria is not a chore for them — it is how they think. They anticipate the questions engineers will ask before they are asked, and they close gaps before they become problems.
They are a disciplined collaborator. They work closely with the Platform PM without needing everything spelled out, and they work closely with designers and engineering teams without losing the thread of what the product is trying to accomplish. They understand that in a fast-moving, early-stage environment, a strong Product Owner is what stands between a well-articulated vision and a product that drifts from it in the details.

# Product Owner:in System Team (CI/CD & Software Development), 80-100 % #
Tribschenstrasse 4, 6005 Luzern
Du möchtest nicht einfach ein bestehendes Produkt weiterentwickeln, sondern eine neue technische Fähigkeit für unsere gesamte IT aufbauen? Dann könnte diese Rolle genau das Richtige für dich sein.
Mit deiner Leidenschaft für Softwareentwicklung, Automatisierung und CI/CD gestaltest du als technisch versierter Product Owner des System Teams unsere technischen Grundlagen, Plattformen und Standards rund um Software-Entwicklung und modernen IT Betrieb. Damit unterstützt du unsere Teams dabei, Applikationen und Software schneller, sicherer und mit höherer Qualität bereitzustellen.
### **Das erwartet dich** ###
In einer ersten Phase liegt dein Fokus auf drei zentralen Themen:
* Du verantwortest den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung standardisierter CI/CD-Pipelines für unsere zentralen Technologie-Stacks.
* Du definierst gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten verbindliche Mindeststandards für Code, Security und Automatisierung.
* Du unterstützt die Teams im Umgang mit Pipelines und Standards und sorgst dafür, dass diese verständlich, nutzbar und wirksam verankert werden.
In einem nächsten Schritt entwickelst du das System Team gezielt weiter zu einem zentralen Enabler für weitere Teile des Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC):
* Du treibst die Automatisierung über den gesamten Entwicklungs- und Lieferprozess voran.
* Du förderst professionelle Softwareentwicklung mit klaren Standards, wirksamer Automatisierung und einem hohen Reifegrad.
* Du identifizierst Themenfelder mit hohem Nutzen, priorisierst sie und entwickelst sie gemeinsam mit dem Team weiter - zum Beispiel in den Bereichen Testmanagement, Umgebungsmanagement, Release-Management oder Entwicklungsstandards.
* Du schaffst die Grundlage für einheitliche Rahmenbedingungen, Best Practices und wiederverwendbare Lösungen.
* Du sorgst dafür, dass das System Team mit den Anforderungen der Organisation mitwächst und seine Wirkung laufend weiterentwickelt und gezielt ausdehnt.
### **Das bringst du mit** ###
* Du besitzt ein ausgezeichnetes Verständnis für moderne Softwareentwicklung, technische Plattformen und organisationsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit.
* Du denkst strategisch und bist gleichzeitig in der Umsetzung technisch wirksam.
* Du verstehst die Anforderungen moderner Softwareentwicklung und bringst fundierte, mehrjährige Erfahrung in Themen wie CI/CD, Automatisierung, Testing, Release-Management, Integration und DevOps mit - idealerweise aus komplexen Organisationen.
* Du bewegst dich sicher in anspruchsvollen IT-Landschaften - auch im Zusammenspiel von Standardsoftware, Eigenentwicklungen, Cloud-Services und On-Prem-Systemen.
* Du kannst eine klare Produkte-Vision erarbeiten und technische Themen strukturieren, priorisieren und in eine umsetzbare Roadmap übersetzen.
* Du agierst sicher in einem Umfeld mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern und schaffst es, gemeinsame Ziele und verbindliche Leitplanken zu etablieren und wirksam in einer Organisation zu verankern.
* Du denkst strategisch, bleibst aber in der Umsetzung pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert. Du erkennst, wo Standardisierung sinnvoll ist und wo Teams den nötigen Freiraum brauchen.
* Du beherrschst die deutsche Sprache und kommunizierst klar, adressatengerecht sowie überzeugend.
### **Dein nächster Schritt** ###

Wir suchen eine Führungspersönlichkeit für unseren Technischen Dienst! Die Stiftung Lindenhof in Oftringen ist ein etabliertes Alters\- und Pflegeheim mit einem breiten Leistungsangebot. Neben der Pflege und einer eigenen Spitex verfügen wir über eine Gastronomie (inkl. Catering) sowie verschiedene therapeutische Angebote.

Mit rund 280 Mitarbeitenden sind wir ein verlässlicher Arbeitgeber in der Region. Wir suchen eine erfahrene Führungskraft mit Projektmanagement\-Kompetenz, die unseren Technischen Dienst neu strukturiert, bestehende Prozesse hinterfragt und unsere baulichen Projekte professionell vorantreibt.

Deine Hauptaufgabe ist es, unsere Infrastruktur mit professionellem Projektmanagement zu führen. Du hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse, erarbeitest ein ganzheitliches Konzept und setzt dieses Schritt für Schritt um.
Projektleitung \& \-management: Du bist der starke Partner der Geschäftsleitung und übernimmst die Planung, Koordination und Umsetzung von baulichen und infrastrukturellen Projekten. Dazu gehören Gebäudeerneuerungen und Optimierung der Energieeffizienz.
Fach\- \& Führungsverantwortung: Du führst, motivierst und entwickelst Dein Team. Dazu gehören Verantwortliche Technik, Hauswart, Fahrzeugflotte, Garten und ICT.
Verantwortung für Sicherheit \& Compliance: Als delegierter Sicherheitsbeauftragter (SiBe) bist Du der Garant für die Einhaltung aller Vorschriften (VKF, EKAS, Suva) und führst Schulungen in Deinem Bereich durch.
Betrieb \& Unterhalt: Du gewährleistest einen reibungslosen Betrieb aller technischen Anlagen (Schwesternruf etc.), koordinierst Wartungen mit externen Partnern und bist selbst eine „Hands\-on“\-Persönlichkeit, die bei Bedarf mit anpackt.
Dein Profil: Eine Macher\-Persönlichkeit mit Weitsicht
Du bist nicht nur ein hervorragender Techniker, sondern vor allem ein strategischer Denker und erfahrener Projektmanager.
Fachliche Qualifikation: Abgeschlossene Berufslehre als Fachmann/Fachfrau Betriebsunterhalt EFZ, Gebäudetechniker oder ein vergleichbarer handwerklicher/technischer Abschluss mit entsprechender Weiterbildung.
Weiterbildung: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Sicherheitsbeauftragten (SiBe) oder die Bereitschaft, diese nachzuholen.
Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im technischen Gebäudeunterhalt, idealerweise in einem Pflegeheim, Spital oder einer ähnlichen Einrichtung mit hohen Sicherheitsstandards.
Führungskompetenz: Erfahrung in der fachlichen und personellen Führung von Mitarbeitenden sowie starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit, um technische Sachverhalte auch für Nicht\-Techniker verständlich zu machen.
Die entscheidende Eigenschaft Fundierte Projektmanagement\-Erfahrung, um unsere baulichen und infrastrukturellen Herausforderungen strukturiert und erfolgreich anzugehen.

Hypofriend is a next-generation online mortgage advisor using proprietary technology to find customers the best mortgage possible and give holistic financial advice.
Unlike other mortgage advisors or brokers, we use financial insights to guide our customers. By joining us, you will be able to tap into these insights and be part of our path to transform the industry. We provide customers with tools that help them navigate the entire home buying process, from making buying decisions and give advice on the next steps to build wealth in Germany.
As Product Manager you own a slice of that machine end-to-end: the internal platform our advisors and operations team run on, and the AI and automation that make the mortgage process faster and less manual. You will work closely with engineering, design, advisors, and the founders.
Tasks
Own your product area end-to-end — from problem discovery and prioritisation to spec, launch, and measurement.
Build for our advisors and ops team. Improve the CRM, advisory and application workflows, document handling, and lender submission so advisors spend their time advising, not administrating.
Ship AI and automation into the mortgage journey — document extraction and verification, AI-assisted advisory prep, decision support, and agentic workflows — with clear guardrails for accuracy and compliance.
Connect the dots across the funnel. Understand how the customer-facing product, advisor tooling, and lender/partner integrations affect each other, and make trade-offs across them.
Learn the business deeply enough to find the levers. Understand our advice and sales principles, how the market works, and how advisors, banks and agents actually move a case forward. Use that to spot where the business loses value — drop-offs, rework, waiting time — and where a product change unblocks it. A roadmap here is a set of bets on levers, not a wish list of features.
Define success with numbers. Set metrics per initiative (conversion, time-to-offer, advisor capacity per case, automation rate, error rate), instrument them, and report honestly on outcomes.
Write clear specs and keep delivery moving. Groom the backlog, run rituals, unblock engineers, and make the call when scope has to be cut.
Work within a regulated domain. Partner with compliance and our lending partners so what we ship holds up under German mortgage regulation.

2–4 years in product management, ideally on a product with real operational complexity (fintech, marketplace, internal tooling, or workflow automation).
Comfort with numbers and data — you can write your own SQL queries or analyses rather than waiting for someone else.
A practical grasp of what today's AI models can and cannot be trusted with, and how to design around that.
A solid UX foundation — you understand how interface and interaction design shape behaviour, and you can design flows that guide advisors and the CSM team towards the right action instead of just exposing more fields and buttons.
Strong written communication and the ability to make complex financial mechanics feel simple.
Structured, self-directed, and comfortable in a small team where you own the outcome, not just the ticket.
Fluent English. German is a strong plus (our lenders, contracts, and regulation are German).
Interest in mortgages, real estate, or personal finance — the domain rewards people who go deep.

Experience with process automation, document AI, or LLM-based product features in production.
Background in lending, insurance, or another regulated financial product.
Some technical fluency — you can read an API contract and discuss architecture trade-offs with engineers.

What can Hypofriend offer you?
👪 Motivated, interdisciplinary team with years of experience building successful digital products
🏠 Work up to 100% from home, with occasional meetings in our Berlin headquarters
📈 Stock options in a growing company
💼 Excellent career opportunities as our company scales
💥 Help to shape the innovative practices and products which are redefining the German mortgage industry
💻 Latest Macbook
🏃🏼‍♂️ Urban Sports Membership
📍 3-story office at Rosenthaler Platz
A lean team and a flat structure. High independence and end-to-end ownership: you take a problem from discovery to launch to measurement yourself, without layers of approval in between.
Your users sit next to you. Our advisors and CSM team are the people your product serves, so feedback comes in hours rather than after a research cycle — and you see the effect of what you shipped almost immediately.
Big scope, real impact. Three brands and one shared financial picture — a wide surface for a team this size, and decisions that visibly move the business.
Fast pace. We ship, learn and correct quickly instead of planning quarters in advance.
Profitable, bootstrapped and proven. Eight years on the market, 500,000 customers, and we fund ourselves — so the roadmap follows customer value and business sense, not the next funding round. You also get real scale of data to work with.
Genuinely hard problems. Optimisation across lender rules, tax logic, risk and long-term financial outcomes, plus AI and automation applied to a regulated, high-stakes process.
How we work — and who thrives here

s.h: This will be a good fit if you
s.t:
Take initiative by default. When something is unclear or broken, you go and find out, rather than waiting for a decision to arrive.
Solve problems from first principles. You dig into messy, ambiguous situations, form your own view of the root cause, and propose a way forward.
Learn fast and enjoy it. Mortgages, German regulation, lender logic, our internal systems — a lot to absorb, and you will be expected to get up to speed largely on your own.
Handle context switching. On any given day you may move between an AI experiment, an advisor workflow bug, a lender requirement and a data question — and hold several threads open at once without dropping them.

s.h: It probably will not be a good fit if you
s.t:
Prefer one clearly scoped project at a time with minimal interruption.
Want a defined process, an existing playbook, and clear direction on what to work on next.
See the PM role mainly as writing tickets and coordinating rather than digging into the domain and the numbers yourself.
Are uncomfortable making decisions with incomplete information, or need consensus before moving.
First 6 months — what success looks like
Month 1–2: You know the mortgage process end-to-end, have shadowed advisors on real cases, and can articulate the core pillars of our workflow.
Month 3–4: You own a defined area, have a prioritised roadmap for it, and have shipped at least one improvement with a measurable effect on advisor efficiency or conversion.
Month 5–6: You are the go-to person for your domain, running discovery independently, and one AI/automation initiative is live and demonstrably reducing manual work per case.

At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible.

We are hiring the next generation of product managers. AI has collapsed the work that used to sit between an idea and a working version of it, and for the first time, PMs can be true builders. The PMs who win in this era do not manage the work. They build the product, every day, with their own hands.
A Staff Product Manager operates and drives vision across product areas. You own a problem space that spans multiple surfaces, or one so foundational that getting it right shapes how everything else at ClickUp works. You still build.

Track record of mentoring and elevating other PMs, not just shipping your own work.

Generate artifacts that accelerate alignment. Leverage AI to draft PRDs, map user flows, validate product launch readiness, synthesize research and customer feedback, produce competitive analyses, and write release notes.

The Profiles Platform team owns Klaviyo’s core customer data system, the foundation that powers every product experience across the platform. This team is responsible for storing, managing, and serving customer profile data as the source of truth for downstream products like segmentation, flows, reporting, and analytics.

Their work ensures that profile data is accurate, scalable, and usable across the entire product ecosystem. From improving data modeling and computed properties to enabling enterprise-scale ingestion and supporting global compliance needs, this team plays a critical role in making Klaviyo’s platform intelligent and reliable at scale.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the strategy and roadmap for Klaviyo’s Profiles Platform. In this role, you will define how customer profile data is structured, processed, and served across the platform.

You’ll work at the intersection of data infrastructure, computed data, and scalability, ensuring that profile data remains trustworthy and performant as Klaviyo grows into more complex enterprise and global use cases. This is a high-impact platform role where your work will directly influence nearly every product team and customer experience.

Please note that this is an onsite role that requires 5 days/week in our Boston office. Fully remote candidates will not be considered at this time.
How You’ll Make a Difference
Own the strategy and roadmap for Klaviyo’s core profile data system, including profile traits, transformations, and storage layers
Serve as the product owner for the source of truth for customer data across the platform
Partner closely with engineering to evolve profile data architecture and services at massive scale
Collaborate with the Identity, Data, and Consent teams to ensure accurate and unified customer records
Drive improvements in profile data quality, usability, and modeling for downstream consumers (segmentation, flows, analytics, AI)
Enable enterprise and global expansion by supporting data residency, compliance, and regional infrastructure requirements
Define and track key metrics around data quality, performance, and system efficiency
What You’ll Work On
Building a computed properties platform to support derived traits (e.g., LTV, recency/frequency, propensity scoring)
Improving profile data modeling and transformations to make data more usable across the platform
Scaling ingestion systems to support billions of profiles and high-throughput workloads
Reducing cost and improving performance through sharding, traffic smoothing, and optimized write patterns
Supporting identity quality initiatives (e.g., deduplication, multi-email profiles, probabilistic matching)
Enabling regulated and global use cases, including data residency (e.g., EU, Japan) and compliance requirements

You have 6+ years of product management experience, ideally in platform, data infrastructure, or backend systems
You have experience working on data models, pipelines, or large-scale distributed systems
You are comfortable operating in highly technical environments and partnering closely with engineering
You have experience driving cross-team alignment across multiple stakeholders
You think in terms of systems and tradeoffs (scale, cost, performance, usability)
You can balance long-term platform investments with short-term product needs
You communicate clearly and can translate complex technical concepts into business impact

Experience with customer data platforms (CDPs) or identity systems
Familiarity with data modeling, event pipelines, or storage systems (e.g., KVS, streaming ingestion)
Experience supporting enterprise-scale or high-volume systems
Exposure to AI/analytics platforms that depend on structured customer data
Experience with data residency, privacy, or compliance (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA)

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.
We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. Having grown 10x in the past year, we are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel. Backed by four leading VCs (TQ Ventures, Creandum, Northzone, and Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80 m Series C, we are ready to push beyond.
We are looking for a Technical Product Manager, API Integrations who is based in SEA to join our Supply domain , more specifically in the Integrations team, which is responsible for onboarding carriers onto our system (integrating external systems, harmonizing data structures and building revenue-increasing products for carriers). This is key to scale our business, therefore our focus is on innovation and automation.

Extend functionalities to enable new opportunities.
Automate and innovate our existing inventory (our API product is already used by big players).
Own scoping and management of onboarding new carriers; establish wider scope throughout Asia.
Take a lead role in defining and challenging strategic decisions.
Contribute to the team with process improvements (e.g. Jira, reporting etc.).
Build relationships with key stakeholders (internal/external – C-level).
We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe.

3+ years or more of professional experience in Product Management.
Hands-on experience with the technical side of the product (API / Data products).
Strong stakeholder experience within with ability to influence without direct authority (including C-level executives).
Good at context switching whilst showing proactivity and ownership across your responsibilities.
Experience working with complex products (advantage).
Good management skills (product, process, project, people management).
Experience working within cross-functional teams.
Technical degree or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related studies.
Fluent in English, both verbal and written.

**Swiss AviationSoftware is a 100% subsidiary of Lufthansa Technik, and along with our partners in the Digital Tech Ops Ecosystem, leads the digital transformation of the aviation industry in technical asset operation.

As the developer of the world's leading software AMOS, Swiss-AS manages successfully maintenance, engineering and logistics requirements of modern airlines.

To strengthen our position at the forefront of this global market, we are looking for dedicated employees who would like to work in a fascinating international environment with more than 200 customers worldwide.**
To strengthen our Product Management team in Basel, we are looking for an experienced Product Owner with a strong background in aviation maintenance and production planning.

As Product Owner, you will shape the future of **Production Planning for Aircraft Maintenance**. You will combine your aviation expertise with your product management skills to turn complex operational challenges into valuable software solutions.
You will work closely with customers, aviation experts, Product Management, and software development teams to define the right solutions and bring them successfully to market.
**Tasks**
* Own the **product vision, roadmap, and backlog** for Production Planning.
* Understand customer and industry needs and translate them into clear product requirements.
* Prioritize development activities based on customer value, business goals, and strategic priorities.
* Collaborate closely with software development teams during solution design and delivery.
* Act as the link between customers, aviation experts, and software development.
* Validate product outcomes through customer feedback, product performance, and continuous improvement.
* Stay up to date with aviation regulations, industry standards, and emerging technologies.
* Build relationships with industry experts and contribute to the evolution of industry standards through working groups and conferences.
**Skills**
* Experience as a **Product Owner, Business Analyst, or in a similar software product role**.
* Strong knowledge of **aviation maintenance and production planning**.
* Experience with **MRO software or aviation-related systems** is highly desirable.
* Understanding of Agile product development principles.
* Ability to translate complex business needs into clear software requirements.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* A degree in aviation engineering, computer science, or a related discipline is an advantage.

* Working in an open and cooperative environment with a motivated and friendly team
* Flexible working hours (flex time model)
* Hybrid work model
* Flight and travel discount
* Excellent working conditions in pleasant surroundings
* Good professional and personal development opportunities
* Highly appealing pension fund scheme/retirement savings plan
* An international work environment with people from around the globe
**Workplace & Culture**
This is the environment where your meaningful work impacts our customers, our communities and everyone who experiences AMOS. You develop technical skills, increase your knowledge about aviation and new technologies, meet different cultures, and always be yourself.

Your work significantly impacts people's lives, technically and as human beings, and contributes to the formation of our future. In addition, you can be part of a fantastic multicultural and international team with a family spirit. We love to travel, laugh, work, be creative, play sports, and, last but not least, do our best work together.

Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.
The problem you'll be solving A corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.

s.h: What we´re looking for You have personally written the tickets.

3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
You are technical enough to argue with engineers.
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
You can write.
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.
You write specs worth acting on.
The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter.
You know what looks good.
You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually.
You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide.
No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec.
You want to be coached hard.
Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast.
You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day.
We want to see the workflow, not hear it described.
You want the scope to grow.
The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available.

Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you’ve probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it.

We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We’re approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical.

We’re a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We’re looking for a highly technical, systems-minded Senior Product Manager to lead two critical search intelligence teams: Machine Learning & Recall and Query . Search at Constructor is fundamentally an ML challenge, and this role sits at the absolute entry point of our discovery pipeline, right where shopper intent meets candidate retrieval.
In this role, you will bridge the Query team (understanding what a shopper means across intent, entities, and language) with the Machine Learning & Recall team (retrieving the exact right set of candidate products across massive catalogs).

You will define strategy across both domains, balancing state-of-the-art techniques, such as vector search, semantic parsing, dense embeddings, and LLM-assisted query interpretation, with low-latency production execution.

You won’t be measured on shipping features for the sake of it; you’ll be measured on candidate quality, query accuracy, and driving business outcomes like conversion rate, search-attributed revenue, and revenue per visit.

Set a unified roadmap: Define the multi-quarter vision and strategy across both the Machine Learning & Recall and Query teams, ensuring query understanding and candidate generation evolve hand-in-hand.
Drive Query intelligence: Lead the Query team to push boundaries in tokenization, spell correction, entity extraction, intent classification, and LLM-assisted query parsing across multiple languages.
Advance Recall systems: Lead the Machine Learning & Recall team in evolving candidate generation architecture, seamlessly combining traditional keyword search with modern dense embeddings, vector retrieval, and hybrid recall models.
Move core business metrics: Own measurable lift in search-attributed conversion, revenue per visit, and GMV across all retail customer verticals.
Turn research into production wins: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with ML researchers, data scientists, and software engineers to take SOTA models from research to low-latency, cost-effective production systems.
Balance ML performance trade-offs: Make data-backed decisions balancing model complexity, accuracy, inference latency, compute costs, and real-time execution constraints.
Build evaluation frameworks: Establish robust offline and online measurement systems to evaluate retrieval precision and query understanding accuracy against customer revenue outcomes.
Orchestrate pipeline handoffs: Ensure candidate product sets and query context flow cleanly into downstream ranking and search quality models without signal loss.
Solve systemic issues: Lead technical triage when query interpretation or retrieval anomalies occur, building durable, automated fixes rather than one-off patches.

This role starts on the content platform, and the platform surface it serves is growing. The foundations of the company, identity and access, developer platform, data and the infrastructure everything runs on, are being invested in over the coming year. We are looking for someone whose curiosity does not stop at the edge of their own team, because the interesting problems here sit exactly where those layers meet.
There is genuine ambiguity in this space right now, and a decision or two you would inherit that we have not finished making. We would rather tell you that than have you discover it in month two. The upside is that very little here is set, so the person who takes this shapes the layer everything else in the product is built on for the next several years.

Own the content services every surface depends on. The services and APIs that serve content to the learner surface, the admin surface and everything we build next, plus the delivery path including CDN and video, and file and asset storage.
Own the structural contract. How content is stored, versioned and served so it can be reused and assembled differently for different customers. This is a schema and interface problem before it is a tooling problem, and your measure is whether the contract other teams build against is clear, stable and safe to change.
Own multi tenant separation. Making sure one customer’s content and branding stay theirs. The tenancy model needs a decision and an owner, and that will be one of your first real pieces of work.
Own access, entitlements and data residency. Who can reach what, where data lives, and what we are able to commit to contractually.
Own performance and cost per tenant. If this layer is slow, everything is slow. If it is expensive, it is expensive everywhere.
Carry the platform half of a migration already in flight. We are moving off an incumbent content tool while the current system keeps earning. Sequencing that is the real work, and the order matters more than the ambition.
Own the non functional questions that show up in deals. A meaningful share of our deals slow down in security and compliance review rather than in the pitch, and that is a product problem with a revenue number attached.

s.h: This role is for you if you have
s.t:
Experience with content management as a product, whether that is a CMS, a DAM, a headless content platform or a structured content system at scale. This is our primary preference.
Experience owning platform or infrastructure adjacent product, where success was measured in what other teams could build rather than in features a customer names.
Enough technical depth to be useful and the honesty to say where you are not. You can read an architecture proposal, ask the question that unpicks it, and tell the difference between a researched answer and a fluent one.
The ability to hold your own with senior engineers, infrastructure engineers and security specialists. Not as a peer on implementation, but well enough that a remediation estimate or a tenancy design does not go unchallenged. A previous career as an engineer is a real advantage and not a requirement.
A habit of thinking in seams. Where systems meet, what a contract between them should guarantee, and how to keep a decision reversible rather than walking through a one way door.
The ability to sequence. We are modernising a platform that carries real history while it keeps earning, and the order matters more than the ambition.
Writing. Decisions, tradeoffs and the reasoning behind them, in a way an engineer and an executive can both act on.
Nice to have, and genuinely useful: depth in AI and personalisation, or in infrastructure. Either one compounds with this role, and we are not expecting both.

s.h: This role is not for you if
s.t:
You want to be a delivery manager for the engineers. They are strong and they do not need coordinating. They need decisions and clarity about what matters.
You want to own the authoring and editorial experience itself. A colleague owns that, you will work closely with them, and drawing the seam between you well is part of the job.
You want to run a rewrite programme. Foundations serve outcomes, and a foundation with no customer outcome attached does not get funded here and should not.
You need the surrounding decisions settled before you arrive.

Bits In Glass (BIG) is a high-growth AI and automation consulting firm with offices across Canada, the United States, India, and the United Kingdom. Our portfolio spans more than 10 leading technologies across AI, cloud, data, automation, and business applications.
Recognized globally as a Great Place to Work and the recipient of multiple partner excellence awards, BIG is built on collaboration, innovation, and delivering measurable business outcomes for enterprise clients. We are a team of experienced technology professionals who enjoy solving complex challenges, celebrating wins together, and helping customers modernize with confidence.

s.h: AN EXCITING OPPORTUNITY WITH BIG AND CONVENE AI
s.t:
BIG is excited to be partnering with Convene AI, an AI-focused technology company developing innovative solutions that leverage artificial intelligence to solve real-world business challenges.
As part of this partnership, we are looking for talented professionals to join BIG and work directly on Convene AI projects and initiatives. You will initially be hired as an employee of Bits In Glass , while working closely with the Convene AI team and contributing to the development and growth of their AI solutions.
The role is expected to remain on BIG’s payroll for approximately 12–18 months, with the intention of transitioning to a permanent position directly with Convene AI following this period, subject to business requirements and transition arrangements.This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to an emerging AI organization at an important stage of its growth, while benefiting from the support, culture, and established consulting expertise of Bits In Glass .

You are the tip of the spear. You own the client relationship, the scope, and the definition of done. You decide what gets built, what does not, and when to tell a client no. This is not an internal product management role and it is not a program management role.

You will be embedded with an enterprise client, running discovery, converting messy business problems into AI requirements a pod can build against, and holding a weekly release cadence together while stakeholders change their minds.

Because our contracts are fixed-fee and outcome-based, your scope discipline is directly connected to whether the engagement is profitable. That is real commercial responsibility and we will treat you
accordingly.

Run discovery: map the current process, quantify where the pain and the money are, and identify where an agent creates measurable value rather than novelty.

· Convert business problems into AI requirements with acceptance criteria that can actually be tested, working with the AI Quality Engineer to make them measurable before build starts.

· Own the outcome definition on outcome-based contracts: what "working"means, how it is measured, who signs off, and what happens if the threshold is missed.

· Manage the client-provided domain expert: secure their time in writing up front, and escalate immediately when their availability slips. Weak domain SME support is the single most common cause of slipped go-lives in this model, and catching it early is your job.

· Manage scope ruthlessly. Weekly releases only work if the backlog is disciplined and someone is willing to be unpopular.

· Run the weekly cadence: demo to the client, capture feedback, re-prioritise, and keep the pod pointed at the highest value work.
Own stakeholder alignment across business, IT, security, procurement, and legal, and get security and procurement engaged in week one rather than week nine.

· Partner with the client's change and adoption team so the system gets used, not just delivered.

· Track and report delivery health: burn, risk register, decision log, and benefits realisation against the agreed outcome.

· Surface commercial risk early. Scope creep, weak executive sponsorship, and integration surprises are margin erosion, and you are the early warning system.

3–8 years in product ownership, delivery management, or client-facing consulting, including at least 2 years shipping software rather than only running programmes.

· A track record delivering under fixed-price or outcome-based commercial terms, where scope discipline had financial consequences.

· Fluency in agile delivery at a genuine weekly release cadence, not two-week ceremony.

· Enough technical literacy to challenge an engineer's estimate and to understand why a retrieval pipeline is returning poor answers. You do not need to write code.

· A working understanding of what LLM-based systems can and cannot reliably do, and the confidence to tell a client when their request is not feasible.

· Executive presence. You will hold steering committees with client CIOs, COOs, and business unit heads.

· Experience in at least one of insurance, financial services, healthcare, or a comparably regulated industry.

· Excellent written communication. Ambiguity that survives your documentation becomes a defect later.

· Legally entitled to work in Canada and willing to travel to client sites.

Prior experience at a top-tier strategy consultancy, Big Four, or a specialist delivery boutique.

· A background as a business analyst, engineer, or data professional before moving into product.

· Familiarity with AI quality concepts: evaluation design, acceptance thresholds, and human-in-the-loop workflow design.

· Experience running engagements alongside a separate change management partner.

· Bilingual English and French.

You will own client outcomes, not status reports.

· Four-person pods mean your decisions translate into shipped software within days.

· Outcome-based commercial terms mean the work is judged on whether it created value, which is a more interesting standard to be held to.

· You will work directly with senior operators who have led AI delivery at Fortune 500 scale.

· Real influence over how ConveneAI's delivery model evolves as we scale from the first pods to many.

Produkt Spezialist (m/w/d), 100%
--------------------------------
**Deine :**
Im täglichen Geschäft stellst du sicher, dass Reportings, Produktunterlagen, Kundenanfragen und RFP\-/DDQ\-Prozesse fachlich korrekt, konsistent und termingerecht bearbeitet werden.

Als Produkt Spezialist übernimmst du eigenständig zentrale Aufgaben an der Schnittstelle zwischen Portfoliomanagement, Vertrieb, Marketing, Legal/Compliance und unseren Kunden. Du koordinierst die relevanten Anspruchsgruppen, setzt klare Qualitätsstandards und entwickelst Prozesse und Inhalte kontinuierlich weiter.

Gleichzeitig bringst du komplexe Investmentstrategien verständlich auf den Punkt und unterstützt Vertrieb und Portfoliomanagement in ausgewählten Kundensituationen.
**Was du bewegst:**
Produktmanagement \& Tagesgeschäft
* Du verantwortest die Erstellung, Koordination und Qualitätssicherung regelmässiger Reportings für interne und externe Anspruchsgruppen.
* Du bewirtschaftest und entwickelst Produktunterlagen wie Präsentationen, Factsheets, RFP\-Inhalte sowie rechtliche und regulatorische Dokumente laufend weiter.
* Du bist eine zentrale Anlaufstelle für produktbezogene Kundenanfragen aus den Vertriebseinheiten und koordinierst die erforderlichen Beiträge mit den zuständigen Fachbereichen.
* Du steuerst RFP\-, DDQ\- und Beauty\-Contest\-Prozesse eigenständig \- vom Kick\-off über die inhaltliche Abstimmung bis zur termingerechten Einreichung.
* Du erstellst Spezialauswertungen und Analysen zu Produkten, Portfolios, Performance und Risiken und bereitest die Ergebnisse adressatengerecht auf.
* Du erstellst und aktualisierst Präsentationen für Kundentermine, Roadshows, Due\-Diligence\-Gespräche, Webinare und Investorenveranstaltungen.
* Du koordinierst produktbezogene Inhalte wie Marktkommentare, Investment Updates und weitere vertriebsunterstützende Unterlagen.
* Du übernimmst Support\- und Koordinationsaufgaben rund um Nachhaltigkeit, produktbezogene Daten\-anforderungen und entsprechende Kundenfragebögen.
* Du identifizierst Automatisierungs\- und Optimierungspotenziale im täglichen Arbeitsablauf und setzt Verbesserungen mithilfe moderner Technologien und Tools pragmatisch um.
* Du übernimmst Verantwortung in teamübergreifenden Projekten und sorgst für eine verlässliche Umsetzung im laufenden Betrieb.
Investment\- und Kundenunterstützung
* Du erklärst Anlagestrategien, Portfoliopositionierung, Performance und Risiken klar, präzise und ziel\-gruppengerecht.
* Du unterstützt Vertrieb und Portfoliomanagement in Kundenterminen, Pitches, Due\-Diligence\-Gesprächen und ausgewählten Investorenveranstaltungen.
* Du entwickelst überzeugende Investment Stories und stellst sicher, dass die Kernaussagen über alle Kunden\- und Produktunterlagen hinweg konsistent sind.
* Du bringst Kundenfeedback, regulatorische Anforderungen und Markttrends strukturiert in die Weiter\-entwicklung unserer Produkte und Investmentlösungen ein.
**Was du mitbringst:**
* Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung (ca. 3\-5 Jahre) im Asset Management, idealerweise im Produkt\-management, als Investment beziehungsweise Produkt Spezialist oder in einer vergleichbaren Schnittstellenfunktion.
* Fundierte Kenntnisse von Anlageprodukten, Fondsstrukturen, Kapitalmärkten sowie von Performance\- und Risikokennzahlen.
* Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im selbstständigen Erstellen und Koordinieren von Reportings, Produkt\-unterlagen, Präsentationen sowie RFP\-/DDQ\-Dokumentationen.
* Die Fähigkeit, mehrere parallele Aufgaben und wiederkehrende Fristen im Tagesgeschäft verlässlich zu steuern und dabei einen hohen Qualitätsstandard sicherzustellen.
* Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Investmentthemen verständlich, präzise und überzeugend zu vermitteln.
* Eine strukturierte, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie ein ausgeprägter Qualitätsanspruch mit Blick fürs Detail.
* Hohe Dienstleistungsorientierung, Verbindlichkeit und ein souveränes Auftreten gegenüber internen und externen Anspruchsgruppen.
* Sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Office, insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel, sowie eine hohe Affinität zu digitalen Tools, Automatisierung und neuen Technologien.
* Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Finanzwirtschaft, Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder eine gleichwertige Hochschulausbildung.
* CFA, CIIA oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.
* Fliessende Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. C1\).
* Teamgeist, Eigeninitiative, Pragmatismus und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit über Fachbereiche hinweg.
**Was dich erwartet:**
* Eine verantwortungsvolle Schlüsselrolle im täglichen Produktgeschäft mit engem Austausch zu Portfoliomanagement, Vertrieb, Marketing und weiteren Fachbereichen.
* Viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, Prozesse, Inhalte und Arbeitsweisen aktiv weiter\-zuentwickeln.

What we do At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth.
Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions.
Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts.
After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future.
If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.
What you'll be doing You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.
You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.
We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.
We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team.
Own the wealth product area end to end
Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it
Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all
Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it
Turn the data into something users act on
Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which
Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway
Own the numbers
Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention
Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did
Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you

s.h: What we are looking for You might be a fit if
s.t:
You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on
You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it
You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality.
You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice.
Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it
You're fluent in English; German is a plus
You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany
That usually adds up to around five or more years in product, but we care about the evidence, not the year count. If you came to product from engineering, data science, research, design, financial services, or from a Product Owner role, that counts.

Subscription and paywall experimentation

Your own portfolio, and opinions about it
If you meet most of this and not all of it, apply. We'd rather read your application than guess.
Work authorisation
This role requires an existing right to work in Germany. We're not able to sponsor visas or support relocation for this position, so we can only consider candidates who already hold German or EU work authorisation, or who can obtain it independently. We'd rather tell you now than after four conversations.
What the first six months look like
Month 1: you know the data model, the aggregation layer and its technology behind it. What our analytics do and don't cover, and understand how AI is already being used and where it. You've written down the three things you think are most wrong with the product today
Months 2 to 3: a written, agreed area strategy with a prioritised roadmap, a primary metric with a baseline, and, clear metrics that you will be monitoring and optimizing along the way
Months 3 to 4: the first thing you scoped is live to a user segment, with a read on the primary metric, and with quality measurement behind it if it involves generated output
Months 5 to 6: two or three shipped iterations with measured results, including the ones that didn't work, a quality bar the team applies without you in the room, and at least one junior product manager who's visibly better at their job because of you
You won't be measured on shipping volume. You'll be measured on whether your area got measurably more useful and more trustworthy.
